description:
Indoor modern collaborative space (likely a university or office common area). No people are visible. Main elements observed:
- A stepped, stadium-style seating structure with four visible tiers made of light wood and blue/teal cushions on the upper tiers.
- A row of low bench-style seats in front of the steps with teal cushions (approximately 6 bench segments).
- A cluster of small square ottoman cubes arranged in a rectangular grid to the left of the steps; the cubes are red, orange and yellow (approximately 12 small cubes).
- A long low cabinet/counter along the back left wall with a sink or dispensing station and at least one mounted sanitizer or soap dispenser and a small paper towel or cup holder.
- Multiple posted signs and notices on the cabinet backsplash and on the glass doors (small printed posters, safety or informational signs).
- A large wall graphic on the stepped seating backing with the words "ENGINEERING" and "INNOVATION" (blue geometric sign).
- Glass double doors or a glass partition to the right of the seating area, with additional notices attached.
- Overhead fluorescent or panel lighting in the ceiling and exposed ceiling elements (ducting and beams visible).
- Vertical green fins/panels beside the stepped seating and a mint-green painted soffit above the seating area.
- Carpeted floor in the seating area with a striped pattern, and a smooth floor surface in the corridor to the left.
- A hallway or corridor visible to the left with shelving or storage in the distance.
Overall scene: a quiet, well-lit, indoor collaborative/learning lounge or breakout area designed for informal gatherings, presentations or group work, dominated by modular colorful seating and tiered steps. Approximate object counts: ottoman cubes ~12, bench segments ~6, seating tiers 4, cabinet/counter 1, glass door set 1, ceiling lights several (8+ visible), signage several (multiple).
caption: Aerial View of the Brainstorming Area in the Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing

description: An indoor open workshop / classroom / makerspace with long wooden workbenches, stools, laptops and electronics. The room has multiple large rectangular ceiling lights and exposed ceiling pipes and ducts. Large windows along the right and back walls reveal an exterior area with plants and a metal stair/structure outside. In the foreground and midground are several work tables: one large empty table in the very front, a table with at least four laptops visible, and additional benches farther back with more laptops and equipment. A group of people (about 6 individuals) are gathered toward the left and center of the room; their faces are blurred or not clearly visible. One person stands near a large mounted display/TV in the middle-back of the room that is showing a slide or presentation. A separate computer monitor is on a counter by the windows. A whiteboard on an easel with handwritten notes is positioned on the right side. Other visible items include multiple stools (around ten), storage boxes and plastic bins on counters and shelving, cables and hanging power outlets suspended from the ceiling, small desktop speakers or devices on counters, and printed paper on one table in the foreground. The overall scene appears to be a collaborative work session or class in a technical/maker lab environment.
caption: Close up of the Makerspace building at Innowing.

There are no people or vehicles visible in the historical photograph. The mounted print shows some gloss or reflection from overhead lighting.

description: A classroom laboratory scene showing students working at a long lab bench. At least five students are visible (faces blurred in the photo) clustered around the bench: one in a striped T-shirt with the word 'ALASKA' visible, one in a white lab coat seated or standing at the right edge, and several others leaning over or working in the background. The students are handling glassware and small beakers containing pale yellow liquids; one beaker sits on a blue hotplate or magnetic stirrer. Visible equipment and items on the bench include: several glass beakers (at least 2), a small glass vial or cup being held, a metal clamp/stand or support arm, tubing (orange and white hoses) connected to faucets/sinks, a bottle of reagent or solvent with a black cap, a plastic squeeze bottle, notebooks/papers and pens, and assorted containers and bottles on a shelf along the back wall. The bench area includes a recessed sink with faucet fittings and laboratory taps. Shelving along the back wall holds additional bottles and lab supplies (several bottles visible). The overall scene is a hands-on laboratory experiment in progress, with students observing and manipulating solutions and equipment at the bench.

Several people are seated in the front row (including at least one person in a wheelchair) and a larger group stands behind them. Visible objects and scene elements include: printed backdrops and banners, the Faculty of Engineering / university logo and Chinese text on the banners, multiple small round “WINNER” signs, a small robotic device or trophy in the top photo, chairs, stage/wooden-tiled flooring, ceiling lights and speakers, and framed posters or large photos of engineering imagery on the right. The setting is an academic or institutional space (Faculty of Engineering) used for ceremonies and showcases; the mood is formal and commemorative. Overall there are many people visible across the three photos (approximately several dozen in total), multiple event signage elements, and repeated branding for the Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing and the university’s Faculty of Engineering.
